ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 88% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels forming the base pigmentation, with 12% high-intensity (white) pixels localized in small clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixel clusters (mottling/rosettes) are densely concentrated along the lateral margins and upper trailing edges of both lobes. The central region near the fluke-peduncle junction remains a solid, low-intensity dark field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped notch; approximately 52-degree angle at the vertex with deep indentation relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Moderate frequency serration; 8-11 distinct pixel-amplitude peaks per lobe, with more pronounced valleys located closer to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave sweep trajectory on both lobes, curving inward from the distal tips towards the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread spatial detection of high-contrast white circular and ring-shaped pixel clusters (barnacle scars) across the dorsal-most regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular 3D textured mass at the distal tip of the right lobe, indicating significant barnacle colonization that alters the geometric silhouette of the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe distal tip exhibits a unique bulbous morphology due to external biological growth, creating an asymmetrical profile compared to the tapered left lobe tip.
